title: solanum nigrum subsp. villosum
intro: Solanum nigrum subsp. villosum, commonly known as hairy black nightshade or black nightshade, is a plant species within the Solanum genus, which is characterized by its dark purple berries and hairy stems. The health benefits of Solanum nigrum subsp. villosum include its potential in reducing inflammation, improving immune function, and exerting antioxidant effects, which may help to prevent chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor properties, which have been observed in various studies. The bioactive constituents of Solanum nigrum subsp. villosum include flavonoids, glycosides, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may contribute to its health benefits.
